headline: Ride-hailing is not a luxury. It is how ordinary Ethiopians move.
summary: More than 30 ride-hailing platforms operate in Addis Ababa, competing on fares and vehicle types. The article says the services are now used by ordinary Ethiopians, not only the affluent.
why: Ride-hailing is a fast-growing urban transport and digital platform business, and competition among operators affects fares, driver earnings and platform economics.
